timing_definition: First recorded execution timestamp through completed audit and verification, immediately before receipt serialization.

Run unchanged retained audit.py on B; create and run verify_b.py against hand-derived exact expectations and check A preservation.
Recheck A hashes, compute file hashes, and save and validate receipt_b.json.
